newsitem.title: USA: Sullivan Dental to acquire S.B. Service.
newsitem.headline: Sullivan Dental to acquire S.B. Service.

text.p: Sullivan Dental Products Inc, a distributor of dental supplies and dental equipment, said Tuesday it agreed in principle to buy all of the assets and assume substantially all of the liabilities of S.B. Service, a sterilization equipment repair company based in Enfield, Conn.
S.B. Service repairs and maintains sterilization units for Sullivan and other dealers in the northeastern United States.

This acquisition and the expertise of S.B. Service's personnel will provide the foundation for Sullivan's expansion of its service division to include the repair and maintenance of sterilization units. Sullivan anticipates expanding these new services nationally during 1997, allowing it to handle internally the majority of the sterilizer repair and maintenance volume currently being referred by Sullivan to third-party repair vendors.
